headline: The Omnichannel AI Revenue Operator
executive_read: Traditional B2B cold email and unmonitored RPA bots have reached their systemic limits due to Google/Yahoo's 0.3% spam rules, declining conversions, and compliance penalties (SOX/GDPR). We present 'Airo'—a Quiet AI digital revenue operator integrated natively into enterprise CRM workflows. Airo bridges REST data waterfalls, deep context-isolated memory, and margin preservation architecture to convert passive contacts into high-performing pipeline accounts.
key_findings: Quiet AI Background Processing: Headless APEX and Node.js integrations replace fragile screen-scraping bots (which had 30-50% failure rates).
Deliverability & Bounce Gates: Multi-provider waterfalls (Clay) and in-line verification (ZeroBounce) keep email bounce rates safely below 2%.
PII & SOX Risk Management: Local anonymization proxies isolate customer data, while staged CRM writes maintain immutable SOX Section 404 audit logs.
Margin Protection (Quality-Adjusted TCO): Semantic caching (Redis) and model classifiers (RouteLLM) achieve up to 86% API cost savings.

slides.title: Modules A & B: Data Waterfalls & CRM Memory
left_bullets: Automates cleanup of CRM data decay (30% annual).
Programmatic REST APIs override UI scraping.
right_bullets: Ingests previous email threads and Salesforce history.
Prevents generic AI templates that trigger spam filters.
Personalization raises reply rates from <1% to 18%.

slides.title: Modules C & D: Compliance Gates & Social Warmup
left_bullets: Locks daily outbound volume to 30-50 per inbox.
Checks spam likelihood against Postmaster rules.
Filters PII locally to satisfy GDPR Article 44 rules.
Stages updates in CRM to maintain SOX 404 logs.
right_bullets: Scrapes public post activities of target prospects.
Discovers proximity path routes for warm intros.

slides.title: Module E & TCO: Cost Caching & Pricing Models
left_bullets: Uses semantic caching for repeat context (Redis).
Cuts LLM costs by 86% with 40-70% hit rates.
RouteLLM routes simple queries to Flash models.
right_bullets: Hybrid SaaS Model: Metered usage credit pricing.
Productized Service: Outbound audit setup at $4,500/mo.
Digital Blueprint: Deliverability setup manual package.
